At some point following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], a group of individuals was tasked with a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demigue]]. The group had to retrieve a unique, valuable [[Ring/Legends|ring]] that had been given as a gift by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Marilla]] of the planet [[Gascon]] to [[Gender/Legends|her]] lover, Demigue's [[Prime Minister (Demigue)|Prime Minister]].<ref name="Envoy">{{WEGCite|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Screen|story=Envoy to the Queen}}</ref>
